sample_email_subject: Accelerate Project Readiness – Smart Binders & Auto-Replenish for Ram Windows' Next Growth Leap
sample_email_body:
Hi Kristin and Tamika,

We’re delighted to see Ram Windows’ surge in purchases this year. Kristin, your momentum has set a high bar, and Tamika, welcome back—your recent orders in presentation supplies haven’t gone unnoticed!

To help your teams deliver complete project kits on time, we recommend:
• Custom-logo binders and matching accessories for your job-site and client documentation
• Scheduled auto-replenishment timed to your project starts (never run short again)
• Fast setup of personalized Favorites Folders, so repeat orders are just a click away

We’d love to schedule a quick 5-minute walkthrough of the Staples Auto-Restock Tool—let us show you how Kristin’s core binder SKUs and Tamika’s favorites can auto-populate for future orders, cutting admin time dramatically.

As a bonus, we can provide a single-invoice solution to simplify A/P and cost controls—a win for your finance team as well.

Ready to take the next step or have questions? Reply here to set up a Teams meeting, or dive into your curated cart anytime at your StaplesAdvantage portal.

Thank you for choosing Staples—let’s make project kickoff even smoother at Ram Windows!

Best regards,
Victoria Grant
Manager, Account Expert Team
On behalf of the Staples Expert Team
Staplesexpertteam@staples.com
